annotations.title: Check if a land use is allowed

description: Whether a named land use is permitted, conditional or prohibited in a covered jurisdiction's published zoning table, with the exact table row and page citation. Unsure answers are UNKNOWN and a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged. $0.15 per call in USDC. Verified against official sources and cited to the page; a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged. Per-jurisdiction data dates: see check_coverage.
name: check_use_allowed
title: Check if a land use is allowed
